notes.title: Shinobi Rising Status Update
notes.notes:
Good morning community

As you may have noticed from our last update in 2023, after the launch of this game and realising that we had not hit our goals or vision for this game - a major update was announced.

Soon after that, due to the volatility of the game industry being what it was then, we were forced to close down the London team that worked on this game.

We have survived the madness of the game industry over the last few years due to a strong tabletop game production pipeline in the game company. We have rebuilt the game dev team now and the company has relocated to Singapore and is now back in action and with several new games under development for PC/Console and mobile.

Shinobi Rising is being reviewed to find a way to bring back into our development pipeline as either a major new update to this game or a full remastered version that will add all the missing elements we wanted from the original vision and go for a bigger more feature rich game with co-op multiplayer added in as well.

I will keep you posted over the coming period on the progress as we continue the planning. We are currently in the stage where we are discussing with our publishing/distribution network on what version of this game they are prepared to back and bring to market. Once we have that ironed out, I will be in a position to be more exact.

notes.title: Publisher changes, RTX and DLSS additions and more!
notes.notes:
Good afternoon community!

Due to the ongoing volatility of the game industry sadly, W.R.K.S Games has shuttered its development and publishing operations as a company as of October 1st. We are not in dire straits, but we do think that the mid-market of the game industry is no longer viable for self-funded self-published indies in the current and near-term future of the industry.

All the full-time staff was outplaced to new jobs and the shutdown is graceful. W.R.K.S Games is going to continue to exist as a company that licenses its IP to third parties to continue development and fan engagement.

For video games like Shinobi Rising, as the original Founder of W.R.K.S Games, I will own the license to continue the development of the games on my own label Kos Games and you will see this reflected on the Steam page as of now. The game will continue its development and the fan base will continue to be supported by my personal label. I are aiming for an AA-quality standard of games with a small independent team.

I will helm lead development myself on the upcoming major changes to Shinobi Rising and other future games in the Katana-Ra IP universe.

I am going to post on going updates here regularly on how the revamp of this game is going, and to start off with I am going to be upscaling the visual fidelity of the game, adding RTX and DLSS to the title and significantly more controls to graphics and video settings including HDR support. notes.title: Major Update In the Works
notes.notes:
Good morning community!

Apologies to start with, for the long radio silence. I am having a turbulent time these days between work and a home move that is hitting more hurdles than expected.

I have been listening to the feedback I have been getting on Steam, as well as our Korea and Japan launch that has now concluded. I see that the actual experience of the game fell short of what I intended for this at the launch version of the game.

In the last few months I have been poking around when possible to see areas of improvement and taking in feedback and there is now clarity on the path ahead.

A very comprehensive overhaul and update to the game is now afoot and I hope to complete by December end. I will be updating locomotion and movement, combat, adding new combat options, adding verticality, and adding more story and investigation elements into the game.

I will also be overhauling the game map with more focus on the traditional mountain village feel, that people seemed to like and less on the modern cyberpunk themes for this first map.

I will have comprehensive patch notes together with the update in December, until then - know that the game has not been abandoned and updates are coming! I am grateful for the people that purchased this and I have a clear path to improvement ahead of me now.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Update 1.1: The Community Feedback Patch
notes.notes:
Good morning all!

Happy Sunday to the community and welcome to Update 1.1: The Community Feedback Patch

Our goal with this patch is to polish the launch build and improve the core gaming experience. No new features were added in this patch, but the overall game experience should now feel more polished, less random weirdness occurring, and better paced.

Nearly all the changes today are from community and player feedback - so thank you for that!

[h3]Control System[/h3]
The primary recommended method for playing the game continues to be a mouse and keyboard. Controller functionality is fully implemented and improved in this patch.

In the controller version, the camera is fixed. Camera rotation or "look around" has been implemented but when you move the camera will realign to its designated location. To not set the camera would be a tad weird for a top-down angle game.

[h3]A note on Game Difficulty[/h3]
The game is designed to be hard. We had a lot of pushback at launch on game difficulty. I do not want to dumb down the game into an easy mode - as that is not the goal of this game. I have however done the following to streamline the experience:

[list]
[*] Three difficulty levels were added in the last patch - these have been better balanced.
[*] The tutorial section is easier, you will not get two shotted by enemies or suddenly killed during the tutorial phase.
[*] Game and enemy difficulty escalates as the game goes on, giving you time to learn and practice the method you wish to experience the game in.
[*] IN PROGRESS - A feature has been added to the game to fix line-of-sight issues between the character and objects obscuring your view as a player. However, although this works in Unreal Engine when we test it, it has been noticed that in the packaged build of the game (the one you play on Steam), this occasionally fails to work. This appears to be an Unreal Engine issue and we have escalated this to Epic Games to advise on what to do about it. We will issue a hotfix before the end of this month with any solutions they provide.
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The delay timing between Wound and Finish combat animations was too long causing, the stun timer to expire too fast on enemies. This has now been rectified
[*] Visual effects have been improved
[*] Added more ambiance to nature and village night
[*] Unnecessary markers and health widget removed from enemies
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The background music was suddenly stopping at times - FIXED
[*] Music was not swapping correctly sometimes between non-combat and combat state - FIXED
[*] The Guard Captain movement animation was bugged - FIXED
[*] Sound of gunfire was not triggering nearby guards - FIXED
[*] Death animation on guards was intermittently failing - FIXED
[*] Rotation not facing target when Jin was blocking - FIXED
[*] Guard captain taunt animation bug and hit reaction animations occasionally bugged out - FIXED
[*] The game HUD toggle on load game bugged sometimes - FIXED
[*] During combat on an incline the character rotation would rotate the entire character ay a weird in angle in very specific circumstances - FIXED
[*] Jin's Vanish skill did not correctly remove his combat status - FIXED
[/list]

[h3]Game Enjoyment[/h3]
We received 6 refunds from people that cited "Game Not Fun" as their reason. Keep in mind that the same was designed as a stealth game where failure in that activity has significant consequences. The game is inherently hard and mistakes are punishing. It's not the kind of game you rush through. Victory and success are given to those that go slow and steadily.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - The Quality of LIfe Patch
notes.notes:
Good afternoon all!

Thank you for the quick feedback looks following the launch last week. We have managed to sort out a patch relatively fast to address the major quality of life issues that people wanted, here is the full patch notes:

[h3]Features[/h3]
[b]Full Controller Support [/b]- more improvements are still needed on this. Everything works with a controller, however, due to the fact that the character and the camera operate independently - in parts of the map this still causes issues. We will continue to iterate on that in upcoming patches. Mouse and Keyboard still is the most seamless way to play the game for now.

[b]Steam Deck Support[/b] - Now that controller support is implemented, you can play on a Steam Deck.

[b]Steam Cloud Saves [/b]- Steam now saves your save game to the cloud.

[b]New difficulty levels added[/b] - We noticed that many people were having difficulty getting past the tutorial mini-boss. Three difficulty levels now exist in the game.

[b]Korean Launguage Added[/b] - Because we are launching in Korea soon :D

[b]Low Graphics Settings Removed[/b] - This was added initially because the game is an Unreal 5 engine game, and I wanted an option for people with old machines to play the game. This caused more issues than it solved - this has been removed.

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
Indicators improved for combat targeting - There were too many indicators. Some were too small. This has been fixed.

[b]Right click rotation improved[/b] - Right click rotation has moved to a more standard click, hold and rotate model.

[b]Increased camera time on post-death clues[/b] - camera time on clue hints was too fast, this has been improved

[b]Guard Captain boss fight grenade projectile bug fixed[/b] - The grenade projectile was just going all over the place. It is now more targeted.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[b]Staircase collision bug [/b]- The first staircase by the first clue is occasionally bugged out in a collision. This has been fixed.

[b]Intermittent bug on Disengage fixed[/b] - Sometimes when you Disengage, the enemy does not de-aggro. This has been fixed.

Thank you for supporting us, we will continue to add to the game over time and the post-launch Roadmap will be posted next week!

notes.title: Shinobi Rising Release and Post Launch Plans
notes.notes:
Good afternoon all!

Shinobi Rising will release tomorrow at the following times:

UK: 5 pm
CET: 4 pm
Mountain Time: 10 am
Central Time: 11am
Pacific Time: 12 noon
Beijing: Midnight
Japan : 1 am

Following the launch, I will give it a week to see the first feedback round from players on how everyone is taking it and the reveal of any bugs or issues we may have missed in QA and Testing.

In the first week of May, we will do the first post-launch patch to address any issues if any are found.

In the last week of May, the Game+ mode will be released with Steam achievements and game feature updates. I will detail what will be available in that first free content patch a couple of weeks before launch.

Enjoy the game, and looking forward to the feedback!
